fields.label: Recommendation
fields.description: The recommendation this action responds to. Mandatory — the only correlation path between a CRM Sales Action and a CRM Recommendation; never inferred by student+timestamp proximity.

fields.label: Student
fields.description: Denormalized from the recommendation for query convenience only — not a substitute join key for recommendation-correlation.

fields.label: Student Task
fields.description: The single v2 task anchor; legacy actions may leave this blank.

fields.label: Action Type
fields.options:
WAIT
CALL
EMAIL
MESSAGE
COUNSELING
MEETING
EVENT_INVITE
CAMPUS_VISIT
DOCUMENT_REQUEST
APPLICATION_SUPPORT
PARENT_CONTACT
HANDOFF
FOLLOW_UP
fields.description: Sourced from app/agents/decision/action_types.py's ACTION_TYPES — the single canonical vocabulary.

fields.label: Execution Status
fields.description: Whether this action was carried out — no judgment about whether it worked, see business_outcome for that.

fields.label: Business Outcome
fields.options:
NO_RESPONSE
INTEREST_INCREASED
NEEDS_MORE_INFORMATION
CALL_BACK_LATER
APPLICATION_STARTED
APPLICATION_COMPLETED
NOT_INTERESTED
fields.description: What happened as a result of this action, independent of execution_status — a completed action can still have a negative outcome. Sales-facing/evaluation-only; does not feed the scoring pipeline.

fields.label: Linked Interaction
fields.description: Set only when this action's execution produced a CRM Interaction record. When set, the sole explicit correlation to CRM Interaction — never inferred by student+timestamp proximity.
